message.name: UWB_RANGING
message.description: Message used to stream ranging results. Contains up to 15 measurements.
message.field: Base time for measurements, milliseconds elapsed since ranging start.
Number of measurements present.
System ID of the first device for every measurement.
System ID of the second device for every measurement.
Relative offset for a measurement to the base_time, in milliseconds.
Measured distance in mm.

message.name: UWB_RANGING_PACKED
message.description: Message used to stream ranging results. Contains up to 15 measurements.
message.field: Base time for measurements, milliseconds elapsed since the device clock start.
Sequence of 6 byte elements, repeated for every measurement: [time_offset_ms, device_a, device_b, distance_cm, distance_cm >> 8, distance_cm >> 16]. Sequence end is marked by device_a == 0.

message.name: UWB_RANGING_DEBUG
message.description: Message used to stream ranging results. Contains up to 15 measurements.
message.field: Base time for measurements, milliseconds elapsed since the device clock start.

Sequence of 11 byte elements, repeated for every measurement: [time_offset_ms, device_a, device_b, distance_cm, distance_cm >> 8, distance_cm >> 16, ppb_difference, ppb_difference >> 8, velocity_cm, velocity_cm >> 8, nlos_avg]. Sequence end is marked by device_a == 0.

message.name: UWB_POSITIONING_REFERENCE
message.description: Message used to specify current reference coordinates for a single device.
message.field: Reference time, milliseconds elapsed since the device clock start.
Reference type. 0 - no reference, 1 - static reference in the shared frame of reference, 2 - reference in a moving frame of reference, 3 - reference provided by an external positioning device.

Precision specification in the form of available most significant bits per every of the six measured values. The lowest 5 bits of 'msb' specify the number of significant bits in X value starting from the most significant bit, the bits 5-10 specify it for the Y value, etc.
Array of 6 elements: coordinates (0-2) X, Y, Z and then velocities (3-5) VX, VY, VZ. [mm, mm, mm, mm/s, mm/s, mm/s] correspondingly.

message.name: UWB_POSITIONING
message.description: Message used to stream positioning results. Contains single position measurement.
message.field: Measurement time, milliseconds elapsed since the device clock start.
Device ID.

Precision specification in the form of available most significant bits per every of the six measured values. The lowest 5 bits of 'msb' specify number of significant bits in X value starting from the most significant bit, the bits 5-10 specify it for the Y value, etc.
Array of 6 elements: coordinates X, Y, Z and then velocities VX, VY, VZ. mm, mm/s correspondingly.

message.name: UWB_LINK_METRICS
message.description: Channel/link metric table folded by running average. The table covers every directed pair of the network (sender, receiver), as heard by the receiver. One metric is carried per message, identified by metric_code.
message.field: Time of the newest sample folded into this table, milliseconds elapsed since the device clock start.
1-byte code of the metric held in data. 0 - reserved/invalid.
Maximum device count of this network (N). The table holds N*(N-1) elements.

One byte per directed pair, in ascending index order, index = receiver_index * (N-1) + (sender_index less than receiver_index ? sender_index : sender_index - 1), where receiver_index and sender_index are device orders minus 1. Decoded back as: receiver_index = index / (N-1), remainder = index % (N-1), sender_index = remainder if remainder is less than receiver_index, otherwise remainder + 1. Measured values are stored as value + 1, clamped to 0xFF, so decode them as data - 1. 0x00 - this device has no samples for that pair.

message.field: Device time, milliseconds elapsed since the device clock start.
